plan_review.notes: Reviewed before implementation. Paired baseline/current reproduction and first-decision trace were added to the plan; controls now include exact release options, a forced-weapon matrix, and paired official-win determinism assertions.

code_review.notes: Final review found one low-risk stale integration-test setup guard after the recovery fixture moved the gold near the player; lowered the anchor requirement and updated the docstring before final validation.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly bounds the pre-exit loot sweep to the AI's scan radius, preventing dangerous cross-map sweeps that lead to late-run deaths. The unit and integration tests were thoroughly and correctly updated to reflect the new bounded behavior, and a regression seed was appropriately added to the headless suite. The code is highly disciplined, well-commented, and fully policy-compliant.
